fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary on Miami city commission elections and Dade County representatives in Tallahassee, with repeated criticism of Florida Power & Light Company and discussion of utility bills and public franchises. Local civic topics include telephone tolls between Miami and nearby cities, traffic safety and accidents, proposed lighter summer uniforms for traffic police, and streetcar/motorman liability. Coverage also touches on real estate conditions (including a lengthy paid political statement by Abe Aronovitz and discussion of Coral Gables property prices), Miami Beach policing and late-night restrictions, preparations for visiting Lions, local transportation and causeway/road projects, and assorted society, entertainment, and sports items, advertisements, and legal notices.
